item.beyondsolo.ascension_key.lore: A key the System handed you. It opens a door that is not there.
item.beyondsolo.ascension_key.use: Use: begin the Trial of Ascension
quest.beyondsolo.job_ascension.desc: You have grown enough to advance. Use the Key of Ascension and clear the trial alone. What you become will be decided there.
notify.beyondsolo.job_unlocked.title: [Job Change]
notify.beyondsolo.job_unlocked.body: You qualify for a job change. Use the Key of Ascension when you are ready.
notify.beyondsolo.job_countdown.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_countdown.body: Entering the trial. You will face it alone.
notify.beyondsolo.job_changed.title: Job change complete
notify.beyondsolo.job_changed.body: %s has advanced to %s. New skills unlocked.
notify.beyondsolo.job_done.title: Job change
notify.beyondsolo.job_locked.title: Job change
notify.beyondsolo.job_wait.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_wait.body: The trial is sealed for %s:%s more.
notify.beyondsolo.job_not_here.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_returned.title: Trial of Ascension
notify.beyondsolo.job_returned.body: You left the trial. You can try again.
chat.beyondsolo.job_rare: The System trembles: %s has become a %s!
job.beyondsolo.trial.title: TRIAL OF ASCENSION
job.beyondsolo.trial.intro: Defeat the Echoes. Face the Warden. Prove you deserve to advance.
job.beyondsolo.trial.boss_near: Something stirs at the far end of the hall.
job.beyondsolo.trial.arbiter_flawless: Flawless so far: don't get hit, and the rare odds double
job.beyondsolo.trial.failed_sub: The System casts you out. You may try again in %s minutes.
job.beyondsolo.reveal.title: JOB CHANGE
job.beyondsolo.reveal.shadows: The shadows answer to you now. Raise your army.
subclass.beyondsolo.bloodrager.desc: Trades blood for fury: the more it bleeds, the harder it hits, and every strike drinks some life back.
subclass.beyondsolo.warlord.desc: A commander on the battlefield. Plants banners that steel allies and break the enemy's will.
subclass.beyondsolo.blademaster.desc: Pure sword discipline. A storm of cuts faster than the eye can follow.
subclass.beyondsolo.juggernaut.desc: Cannot be stopped, cannot be moved. Charges through anything in its path.
subclass.beyondsolo.worldbreaker.desc: One in a hundred warriors. Its fists split the earth and its blood runs like a titan's.
subclass.beyondsolo.nightblade.desc: Strikes from behind in the dark and finishes what is already wounded.
subclass.beyondsolo.toxin_weaver.desc: Weaves poison into the air and into every cut.
subclass.beyondsolo.mirage_dancer.desc: Never where the enemy aims. Blinks from foe to foe in a flurry of afterimages.
subclass.beyondsolo.bounty_reaper.desc: Marks a target, hunts it down, and is paid in full when it falls.
subclass.beyondsolo.eclipse_sovereign.de: One in a hundred assassins. Swallows the battlefield in darkness and rends everything inside it.
subclass.beyondsolo.pyromancer.desc: Calls pillars of fire from the ground and sets every foe it touches alight.
subclass.beyondsolo.stormcaller.desc: Lightning that leaps from foe to foe, and a body that hums with mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.tidecaller.desc: Commands crashing waves that sweep enemies away, and a deep well of mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.necromancer.desc: Speaks with the dead. Drains the life of its foes and raises their shadows as an army that grows with it.
subclass.beyondsolo.starborn_archon.desc: One in a hundred mages. Pulls stars from the sky and folds space into a crushing void.
subclass.beyondsolo.paladin.desc: A holy shield. Smites with light, mends itself, and is deadly to the undead.
subclass.beyondsolo.ironwall_sentinel.de: Roots itself like a fortress and turns every blow back on the attacker.
subclass.beyondsolo.spellward_warden.des: A barrier against magic that turns the damage it takes into mana.
subclass.beyondsolo.vengeance_knight.des: Stores up every wound and returns it twice over in a burst of fire.
subclass.beyondsolo.everlasting_colossus: One in a hundred guardians. Grows to a giant's size and refuses to fall.
subclass.beyondsolo.lightbinder.desc: Bursts of radiant light that heal allies and burn foes.
subclass.beyondsolo.grovekeeper.desc: Grows healing gardens that root enemies in place.
subclass.beyondsolo.spring_oracle.desc: A cleansing tide that washes away poison and curses, and a step ahead of every blow.
subclass.beyondsolo.hemomancer.desc: Heals by bleeding others: siphons life straight from the enemy's veins.
subclass.beyondsolo.dawn_saint.desc: One in a hundred healers. A miracle in human form: restores everyone and judges the dead.
subclass.beyondsolo.sharpshooter.desc: One shot, one kill. Piercing shots from impossible range.
subclass.beyondsolo.wildcaller.desc: Fights alongside a pack of wolves that answers its call.
subclass.beyondsolo.snare_artisan.desc: Lays fields of snares and punishes anything caught in them.
subclass.beyondsolo.storm_archer.desc: Volleys of arrows charged with lightning that arcs between foes.
subclass.beyondsolo.heavenpiercer.desc: One in a hundred rangers. An arrow that splits the sky, and a storm of a thousand more.

skill.beyondsolo.rage_engine.desc: Below half health you deal %s%% more damage.

skill.beyondsolo.unstoppable_charge.desc: Charge %s blocks forward, hurling everything in your path into the air for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.cataclysm_fist.desc: Leap and crash down: %s damage in a huge circle, foes are launched and stunned, then two aftershocks roll out.
skill.beyondsolo.fault_line.desc: The ground erupts in a line ahead of you, %s damage to everything it throws up.
skill.beyondsolo.titan_blood.desc: +%s%% damage with everything and +%s max health.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_execution.desc: Blink behind the creature you look at and strike for %s damage; 2.5x on targets under 30% health.
skill.beyondsolo.miasma_cloud.desc: A poison cloud for %s s: %s damage per second and heavy poison buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.mirage_flurry.desc: Blink between up to %s nearby foes, striking each for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.evasive_step.desc: %s%% chance to dodge an attack completely.

skill.beyondsolo.opening_strike.desc: +%s%% damage to targets at 90% health or more.

skill.beyondsolo.void_rend.desc: Tear through up to 8 foes nearby, striking each for %s damage, then return to where you stood.

skill.beyondsolo.storm_lash.desc: A bolt that deals %s damage and leaps to %s foes in all, a little weaker each jump.
skill.beyondsolo.tidal_crash.desc: A wave crashes ahead: %s damage, foes swept back and slowed, and you recover a little health.
skill.beyondsolo.soul_harvest.desc: Drain every foe around you for %s damage; heal %s and restore 3 mana for each one hit.
skill.beyondsolo.grave_pact.desc: Each kill heals %s and restores %s mana.
skill.beyondsolo.astral_cataclysm.desc: %s stars fall where you look, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.singularity.desc: A point of void pulls in every foe within 9 blocks for 4 s, then collapses for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.celestial_core.desc: +%s max mana, mana regeneration, and +%s%% damage with spells.
skill.beyondsolo.holy_judgment.desc: Smite the creature you look at for %s damage (more against the undead) and heal yourself.
skill.beyondsolo.devotion.desc: +%s armor; below half health you regenerate %s health per second.
skill.beyondsolo.fortress_stance.desc: Root yourself for %s s: Resistance III, and attackers take 30% of their damage back.
skill.beyondsolo.mana_barrier.desc: A barrier of %s absorption health for 12 s; half the damage you take while it lasts comes back as mana.
skill.beyondsolo.retribution.desc: For 6 s you store the damage you take, then explode for twice that plus %s, setting foes alight.
skill.beyondsolo.burning_spite.desc: Creatures that hit you get %s burn buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.colossus_form.desc: Grow to a giant for %s s: +%s max health, much stronger blows, and nothing can push you.
skill.beyondsolo.earthen_domain.desc: A quake through everything within 12 blocks: %s damage, a long stun, and every foe turns on you while you shrug it off.
skill.beyondsolo.undying.desc: A blow that would kill you leaves you at half health instead (once every %s s). +%s max health.
skill.beyondsolo.radiant_burst.desc: Heal allies around you for %s and burn foes for the same (more against the undead).
skill.beyondsolo.blessed_aura.desc: You and allies near you regenerate %s health per second.
skill.beyondsolo.verdant_bloom.desc: A garden for %s s: allies inside heal %s per second, foes are rooted.
skill.beyondsolo.photosynthesis.desc: Regenerate %s health per second under the open sky by day.
skill.beyondsolo.cleansing_tide.desc: A tide that cleanses poison, curses and burns from allies around you and heals them for %s, pushing foes back.
skill.beyondsolo.foresight.desc: +%s max mana and %s%% chance to dodge an attack.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_siphon.desc: Drain the creature you look at for %s damage and blood buildup, healing half of it.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_vigor.desc: +%s max health; your hits add %s blood buildup.
skill.beyondsolo.miracle_of_dawn.desc: Fully heals and cleanses every ally within 16 blocks and shields them; the undead nearby take %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.judgment_of_dawn.desc: %s pillars of light strike the foes around you, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.eternal_grace.desc: Regenerate %s health per second, and survive a killing blow once every %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.deadeye_shot.desc: A piercing shot along your sight, %s damage to everything in the line.
skill.beyondsolo.call_of_the_pack.desc: Summon %s wolves to fight at your side for 30 s.
skill.beyondsolo.snare_field.desc: Scatter snares for 7 s: foes inside are rooted and take %s damage per second.
skill.beyondsolo.field_craft.flavour: A slowed target is an easy one.
skill.beyondsolo.tempest_volley.desc: Fire five charged shots in a fan, %s damage each, every hit arcing to a nearby foe.
skill.beyondsolo.charged_quiver.desc: +%s%% projectile damage and %s%% chance for a hit to spark for extra damage.
skill.beyondsolo.heavens_arrow.desc: One arrow that pierces everything for 80 blocks, %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.storm_of_a_thousand.des: %s arrows rain down on a wide area where you look.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_cleave.desc: Two sweeping cuts in front of you, %s damage each. Every cut builds Blood on what it hits.
skill.beyondsolo.gore_rush.desc: Rush forward through your foes for %s damage each. Every foe you pass through heals you a little.
skill.beyondsolo.thick_blood.flavour: It takes a lot to drain you.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_geyser.desc: A geyser erupts where you aim: %s damage, hurls foes into the air and builds Blood.
skill.beyondsolo.hemorrhage.flavour: A wound that will not close.

skill.beyondsolo.bloodscent.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to foes below half health.
skill.beyondsolo.reckless_slam.flavour: It hurts you too. Worth it.
skill.beyondsolo.reckless_slam.desc: Spend 8% of your health to smash the ground: %s damage to everything around you.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_nova.flavour: Everything you have lost, given back.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_nova.desc: Spend 15% of your health in a burning blast: %s damage around you, up to twice as much the less health you have.
skill.beyondsolo.pain_tolerance.flavour: You stopped noticing a while ago.
skill.beyondsolo.pain_tolerance.desc: Below half health you take %s%% less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.last_stand.desc: For %s s you cannot die: your health never drops below one point, and you hit much harder.
skill.beyondsolo.rallying_cry.desc: You and nearby allies are healed for %s and gain Regeneration and Speed for 5 s.
skill.beyondsolo.spear_of_command.flavou: Where it lands, the army follows.
skill.beyondsolo.spear_of_command.desc: Hurl a spear of light that pierces every foe in its path for %s damage and leaves them weakened.
skill.beyondsolo.vanguard_charge.desc: Charge forward, throwing foes aside for %s damage. Nearby allies gain Speed II.
skill.beyondsolo.banner_of_ruin.desc: Plant a burning banner where you aim for %s s: foes near it take %s damage every second and catch fire.
skill.beyondsolo.war_drums.desc: You and allies within 8 blocks always have Haste %s.
skill.beyondsolo.shield_wall.desc: For %s s, you and nearby allies gain Resistance II and %s absorption hearts.
skill.beyondsolo.execution_order.desc: A blade drops on your target for %s damage and marks it for 12 s: it takes %s%% more damage from everyone.
skill.beyondsolo.spoils_of_war.desc: Every kill restores %s mana and %s health.
skill.beyondsolo.conquerors_verdict.desc: Call down a colossal blade where you aim: %s damage, and everything it hits is stunned.
skill.beyondsolo.iaido.flavour: The cut comes after the sword is sheathed.
skill.beyondsolo.iaido.desc: Flash through your foes. A moment later every one of them is cut for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.crescent_wave.desc: Send a blade of wind 14 blocks ahead: %s damage to every foe it passes.
skill.beyondsolo.rising_moon.flavour: From the ground to the sky.
skill.beyondsolo.rising_moon.desc: An upward cut that throws foes into the air for %s damage, and you with them.
skill.beyondsolo.blade_ward.desc: For %s s spectral blades circle you: Resistance, and foes that come close are cut for %s damage twice a second.
skill.beyondsolo.riposte.desc: %s%% chance to turn a melee blow aside completely and strike back for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.falling_petal.flavour: It lands softly. Nothing else does.
skill.beyondsolo.falling_petal.desc: Leap to where you aim and land in a whirl of cuts: %s damage around you.
skill.beyondsolo.sword_rain.desc: %s spectral swords fall on the area you aim at, %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.wind_step.flavour: Lighter on your feet than the breeze.
skill.beyondsolo.severing_line.flavour: One cut. Nothing more is needed.
skill.beyondsolo.severing_line.desc: Focus, then cut a line 18 blocks long: %s damage, doubled against foes below a quarter of their health.
skill.beyondsolo.seismic_stomp.desc: Stomp the ground: %s damage around you, tossing foes up and slowing them.
skill.beyondsolo.boulder_toss.desc: Hurl a boulder that crashes down where you aim: %s damage and a short stun.
skill.beyondsolo.immovable.flavour: You have never taken a step back.
skill.beyondsolo.stone_skin.desc: For %s s your skin turns to stone: Resistance II and %s absorption hearts.
skill.beyondsolo.grapple_slam.desc: Drag a foe to you, lift it and drive it into the ground: %s damage, and %s to everything near the impact.
skill.beyondsolo.momentum.flavour: Hard to start. Impossible to stop.
skill.beyondsolo.momentum.desc: You deal %s%% more damage while sprinting.
skill.beyondsolo.living_avalanche.desc: For 3 s you barrel forward much faster, battering everything you touch for %s damage four times a second.
skill.beyondsolo.bulwark_taunt.desc: Every creature within 10 blocks turns on you. You gain Resistance and %s absorption hearts.
skill.beyondsolo.second_wind.desc: Below 30%% health you recover %s health every second.
skill.beyondsolo.mountainfall.desc: Leap high and crash down where you aim: %s damage and a stun. The ground keeps shaking for 4 s, slowing foes and dealing %s damage a second.
skill.beyondsolo.tectonic_uppercut.flavo: The earth comes up with the fist.
skill.beyondsolo.tectonic_uppercut.desc: An uppercut that rips up the ground in front of you: %s damage, and foes are thrown sky-high.
skill.beyondsolo.meteor_hurl.flavour: Tear out a hill and throw it.
skill.beyondsolo.meteor_hurl.desc: Hurl a burning boulder that crashes down where you aim: %s damage and sets everything ablaze.
skill.beyondsolo.earthen_might.flavour: The weight of the world, in one arm.
skill.beyondsolo.earthen_might.desc: +%s attack damage, and your blows knock foes further back.
skill.beyondsolo.gravity_well.desc: Drag every foe within 10 blocks to you, then crush them for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.titan_stride.desc: For %s s every second of walking sends out a shockwave: %s damage around you.
skill.beyondsolo.aftershock.desc: Your melee hits send a shock through the ground: %s damage to other foes next to your target.
skill.beyondsolo.continental_split.desc: Three fissures tear outwards in front of you. Each foe caught takes %s damage and is launched.
skill.beyondsolo.worldshaker_roar.desc: A roar that shakes everything within 12 blocks: %s damage and a 3 s stun.
skill.beyondsolo.unbroken.desc: You take %s%% less damage from everything.

skill.beyondsolo.shadow_fang.flavour: They feel it before they see it.
skill.beyondsolo.shadow_fang.desc: Dash through your foes for %s damage each, half again as much from behind or against a foe that has not noticed you.
skill.beyondsolo.dusk_shroud.desc: Vanish for %s s: foes lose track of you, and your first strike out of the shroud deals %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.killer_instinct.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to creatures that are not hunting you.
skill.beyondsolo.throat_slit.desc: A precise cut for %s damage that weakens and slows. Doubled against a foe that has not noticed you.
skill.beyondsolo.umbral_decoy.desc: Leave a shadow of yourself and slip 5 blocks ahead unseen. After 2 s the shadow bursts: %s damage and blindness.
skill.beyondsolo.black_lotus.desc: Shadow blades whirl around you three times, %s damage each, blinding what they cut.
skill.beyondsolo.night_terror.desc: Foes within 8 blocks take %s damage, are thrown back in terror, weakened, and forget who they were hunting.
skill.beyondsolo.finisher.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to foes below 30%% health.
skill.beyondsolo.endless_night.desc: Strike your target from seven sides in an instant for %s damage each, then drop a blade of night on it for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.venom_spit.flavour: Do not get it in your eyes.

skill.beyondsolo.toxic_blood.desc: Creatures that hit you in melee are poisoned (%s buildup).
skill.beyondsolo.spore_burst.desc: A cloud of spores bursts around you: %s damage, poison and a slow.
skill.beyondsolo.paralytic_dart.flavour: It only stings for a second.

skill.beyondsolo.potency.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to poisoned foes.

skill.beyondsolo.antibodies.flavour: You have tried all of them on yourself.

skill.beyondsolo.gale_kick.desc: A spinning kick for %s damage that blasts foes far away from you.
skill.beyondsolo.featherfall.desc: +%s%% movement speed, and you can fall %s blocks further unharmed.
skill.beyondsolo.mirror_image.desc: For %s s mirror images dance around you: %s%% chance that an attack hits one of them instead.
skill.beyondsolo.cyclone_dance.desc: Whirl for 1.5 s, dragging foes in and cutting them for %s damage five times.
skill.beyondsolo.updraft.desc: A blast of wind for %s damage hurls nearby foes into the air and lifts you with them. You float down slowly.
skill.beyondsolo.afterimage_barrage.flav: Five of you, one after another.

skill.beyondsolo.slipstream.flavour: Hard to hit what will not stay still.
skill.beyondsolo.slipstream.desc: You take %s%% less damage while sprinting.
skill.beyondsolo.tempest_waltz.desc: Flit between foes within 12 blocks, cutting twelve times for %s damage, then return in a burst of wind for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.chain_hook.desc: Hook the foe in your sights and drag it to you: %s damage and a slow.
skill.beyondsolo.reaping_arc.desc: A sweeping scythe cut and its backswing: %s damage, then half again. Marked foes take 50%% more.
skill.beyondsolo.bounty_ledger.desc: Every kill gives you Speed II for %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.crippling_shot.flavour: They do not run after this.

skill.beyondsolo.penumbra.flavour: The edge of the shadow cuts too.

skill.beyondsolo.lord_of_night.desc: You take %s%% less damage from everything.

skill.beyondsolo.flame_wall.desc: Raise a wall of fire in front of you for 5 s. Foes in it take %s damage twice a second and burn.
skill.beyondsolo.pyromania.flavour: It is prettier when it burns.
skill.beyondsolo.pyromania.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to burning foes.

skill.beyondsolo.phoenix_dive.desc: Leap to where you aim and land in flames: %s damage, fire and a knockback to everything around you.

skill.beyondsolo.ball_lightning.desc: Send a slow orb of lightning forward for 3 s. It shocks every foe near it for %s damage four times a second.
skill.beyondsolo.overcharge.flavour: Too much is the right amount.
skill.beyondsolo.overcharge.desc: Your hits have a %s%% chance to stun for 1 s.
skill.beyondsolo.thunderclap.desc: A clap of thunder around you: %s damage, a knockback and a 1.5 s stun.
skill.beyondsolo.lightning_dash.desc: Become lightning and flash 9 blocks forward: %s damage and a stun to everything you pass through.
skill.beyondsolo.conductivity.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to foes that are slowed, stunned or wet.
skill.beyondsolo.storm_cage.desc: Trap the spot you aim at in a cage of lightning for 4 s. Foes inside take %s damage twice a second, are slowed and cannot leave.
skill.beyondsolo.tempest_call.desc: Nine thunderbolts strike foes around you over 3 s, each for %s damage and a short stun.
skill.beyondsolo.judgment_of_thunder.des: Gather the storm for 1.5 s, then drop it where you aim: %s damage and a 3 s stun within 8 blocks, and arcs for %s damage to foes farther out.
skill.beyondsolo.water_whip.desc: Lash the foes in front of you for %s damage and drag them towards you.
skill.beyondsolo.bubble_prison.desc: Lift your target in a bubble for %s s, helpless. It takes %s damage when caught and again when the bubble bursts.
skill.beyondsolo.undertow.desc: Your hits slow foes for %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.riptide.desc: Surge forward on a wave: %s damage to everything you pass, thrown aside.
skill.beyondsolo.healing_rain.desc: Rain falls around you for 6 s. Allies in it heal %s health a second and stop burning; foes are slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.maelstrom.desc: Open a whirlpool where you aim for 4 s. It drags foes in and deals %s damage twice a second.
skill.beyondsolo.tsunami.desc: A great wave rolls 18 blocks forward: %s damage, and everything it meets is carried away.
skill.beyondsolo.abyssal_deluge.desc: A vast whirlpool drags in everything within 12 blocks for 3 s, then erupts: %s damage and foes are hurled skyward. Allies in it heal %s.
skill.beyondsolo.bone_spear.desc: A spear of bone pierces everything in its path for %s damage and withers it.
skill.beyondsolo.withering_curse.desc: Curse your target for %s s: it withers, weakens, and takes %s damage now.
skill.beyondsolo.necrotic_might.flavour: A little death in every touch.
skill.beyondsolo.necrotic_might.desc: Your hits wither foes for %s s.
skill.beyondsolo.grave_burst.desc: Bones erupt from the ground where you aim: %s damage, and foes are thrown up and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.life_drain.desc: Drain your target for 2 s: %s damage four times a second, and each pulse heals you for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.spirit_swarm.desc: Six spirits fly at foes around you, each for %s damage and withering.
skill.beyondsolo.curse_of_frailty.desc: Curse the foes where you aim for 8 s: they are weakened and take %s%% more damage from everyone.
skill.beyondsolo.deaths_embrace.flavour: Closer to it, stronger for it.
skill.beyondsolo.deaths_embrace.desc: While below half health you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.requiem.desc: Sing for 2 s, then every foe within 12 blocks takes %s damage, doubled against those below 20%% health. Each one struck heals you and restores mana.
skill.beyondsolo.star_bolt.desc: Three bolts of starlight strike your target for %s damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.comet.desc: A comet lands where you aim: %s damage within 4 blocks, and foes are thrown up.
skill.beyondsolo.event_horizon.desc: Blink 10 blocks forward and leave a collapsing star behind. It drags foes in for 1 s, then bursts for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.constellation.desc: Link up to six foes around you with starlight. A moment later each takes %s damage, plus %s for every foe in the link.
skill.beyondsolo.supernova.desc: Gather light for a moment, then burst: %s damage, blindness and a hard knockback within 9 blocks.
skill.beyondsolo.astral_aegis.desc: For %s s you take %s%% less damage and everyone who strikes you takes %s damage back.
skill.beyondsolo.genesis_ray.desc: Pour out a beam for 2.5 s that follows your gaze: %s damage four times a second to everything in it, then the far end bursts for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.hammer_of_dawn.desc: Throw a hammer of light at your target: %s damage and a 1 s stun. Undead take half again as much.
skill.beyondsolo.consecrate.desc: Bless the ground within 5 blocks for 6 s. Foes on it take %s damage twice a second, doubled for undead, and allies on it are healed.
skill.beyondsolo.zeal.desc: Each melee hit heals you for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.shield_of_faith.desc: You and every ally within 8 blocks gain a barrier that absorbs %s damage for 8 s.
skill.beyondsolo.radiant_charge.desc: Charge 8 blocks behind your shield: %s damage and blindness to everything in the way, and it is thrown aside.
skill.beyondsolo.aura_of_resolve.desc: You and allies within 8 blocks regain %s health every second.
skill.beyondsolo.lay_on_hands.desc: Heal the ally you look at, or yourself, for %s%% of maximum health and wash away harmful effects.
skill.beyondsolo.divine_verdict.desc: Light falls on your target: %s damage and a 1.5 s stun, half again as much against undead. Foes within 3 blocks take part of it.
skill.beyondsolo.martyr.desc: Below half health you take %s%% less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.dawnbreaker.desc: Raise a hammer of light and bring it down in front of you after 1.5 s: %s damage, blindness and a knockback within 10 blocks, half again as much against undead. Allies in the light regain 30%% health.
skill.beyondsolo.shield_slam.desc: Slam your shield into the foes in front of you: %s damage, a short stun and a knockback. They turn on you.
skill.beyondsolo.rampart.flavour: A wall where you want one.
skill.beyondsolo.rampart.desc: Raise a wall of stone 7 blocks wide in front of you for 8 s. Foes under it take %s damage and nothing walks through it.
skill.beyondsolo.iron_tether.desc: Hook a foe up to 16 blocks away with a chain and drag it to you: %s damage and a 3 s slow. It turns on you.
skill.beyondsolo.brace.desc: Set your shield for %s s: you take 70%% less damage, and melee attackers take %s damage and are thrown back.
skill.beyondsolo.garrison.desc: You take %s%% less damage while you are not sprinting.
skill.beyondsolo.tremor_march.desc: Four heavy steps over 2 s. Each shakes the ground within 4.5 blocks for %s damage and a slow, and draws foes to you.
skill.beyondsolo.shield_toss.desc: Throw your shield. It bounces between up to five foes for %s damage and a short stun each, then flies back to you.
skill.beyondsolo.citadel.desc: Plant yourself for 10 s. You take 60%% less damage, allies within 8 blocks take less too, and foes inside take %s damage a second, are slowed and turn on you.
skill.beyondsolo.rune_strike.desc: A runed swing in front of you: %s magic damage and weakness for 4 s. A hit restores 4 mana.
skill.beyondsolo.null_field.desc: A dome within 5 blocks for 6 s. Foes inside take %s damage twice a second and are weakened and slowed.
skill.beyondsolo.mirror_ward.desc: For %s s spells and projectiles deal 70%% less damage to you and their caster takes %s damage back.
skill.beyondsolo.warding_bolt.desc: A bolt of ward-light strikes your target for %s damage and leaves you a small barrier.
skill.beyondsolo.runic_armor.desc: Each time a foe strikes you, you regain %s mana.
skill.beyondsolo.binding_glyph.desc: Draw a glyph where you aim. The first foe to step on it within 10 s sets it off: %s damage and a 2.5 s stun within 4 blocks.
skill.beyondsolo.purge.desc: A wave within 8 blocks: foes take %s damage and lose their helpful effects, allies lose their harmful ones.
skill.beyondsolo.spell_eater.desc: Spells and projectiles deal %s%% less damage to you.
skill.beyondsolo.arcanum.desc: For 8 s you take half damage, and almost none from spells. Foes within 6 blocks take %s damage a second and turn on you. Then the ward shatters for %s damage within 9 blocks.
skill.beyondsolo.searing_brand.desc: Brand the foe in front of you: %s damage, it burns, and for 6 s your hits deal %s%% more to it.
skill.beyondsolo.vengeful_leap.desc: Leap up to 12 blocks and land burning: %s damage within 4 blocks and the foes there catch fire and turn on you.
skill.beyondsolo.grudge.desc: After a foe strikes you, your next hit within 5 s deals %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.cinder_chain.desc: Hook a foe up to 14 blocks away with a burning chain and drag it to you: %s damage and it catches fire.
skill.beyondsolo.wrath.desc: For 8 s you deal %s%% more damage and your melee hits scorch other foes nearby for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.ashen_hide.desc: Fire deals %s%% less damage to you, and you gain +%s armor.
skill.beyondsolo.eye_for_an_eye.desc: For 5 s you take half damage and remember the rest. Then it comes back out: %s damage plus what you swallowed, within 6 blocks, and it burns.
skill.beyondsolo.funeral_pyre.desc: A pillar of fire where you aim for 4 s: %s damage twice a second within 3 blocks, and it burns.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_debt.desc: Below 40%% health you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.day_of_reckoning.desc: Mark up to six foes within 12 blocks. A burning blow falls on each for %s damage, then the ground erupts for %s within 10 blocks. You fight in Wrath for 10 s.
skill.beyondsolo.stone_fist.desc: A punch that breaks the ground in front of you: %s damage and a hard knockback within 6 blocks.
skill.beyondsolo.bedrock_skin.desc: For 8 s stone covers you: it absorbs %s damage and you take less from everything else.
skill.beyondsolo.landslide.desc: The ground rolls 12 blocks forward from you: %s damage and foes are thrown up.
skill.beyondsolo.monolith.desc: A pillar of rock bursts up where you aim: %s damage within 3 blocks, and foes are thrown high and stunned for 2 s.
skill.beyondsolo.grasp_of_the_earth.desc: Stone hands seize every foe within 8 blocks: %s damage and a 3 s stun. They turn on you.
skill.beyondsolo.stonewake.desc: Charge 10 blocks and break the ground as you go: %s damage to everything in the way, and it is thrown hard aside.
skill.beyondsolo.pillars_of_creation.des: Eight pillars of rock burst up in a ring around you, each for %s damage. Then the ground inside the ring gives way: %s damage, a 3 s stun and foes are thrown high within 10 blocks.
skill.beyondsolo.sunbeam.desc: A shaft of sunlight falls on the creature you are looking at: %s damage, half again to the undead. You and allies within 8 blocks are mended for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.binding_light.desc: Bonds of light hold the creature you are looking at for %s s and sear it for %s damage twice a second.
skill.beyondsolo.inner_radiance.flavour: There is more where that came from.
skill.beyondsolo.inner_radiance.desc: +%s maximum mana, and your healing is %s%% stronger.
skill.beyondsolo.motes_of_mercy.desc: Three motes of light circle you and each ally within 8 blocks for 12 s. Each blow that lands on someone spends one of their motes to mend them for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.lantern_of_mercy.desc: Hang a lantern of light where you are looking for 8 s. Every second it mends allies within 6 blocks for %s and sears the nearest foe within 8 for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.afterglow.desc: For 5 s after one of your skills heals someone, you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.solar_flare.desc: A blinding flash: %s damage to foes within 7 blocks, half again to the undead, and they are blinded, slowed and weakened for 4 s. Allies in reach are mended for %s and see clearly again.
skill.beyondsolo.lightstep.flavour: Gone in a blink of light.
skill.beyondsolo.lightstep.desc: Become light and step to where you are looking, up to 10 blocks away. Foes near where you left take %s damage and are blinded; you and allies near where you arrive are mended for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.last_light.desc: When a blow leaves you under 30%% health, light mends you for %s%% of your maximum health. Once a minute.
skill.beyondsolo.solstice.desc: Raise a sun over the battlefield for 10 s. Every second it burns foes within 12 blocks for %s damage, double to the undead, and mends allies for %s. Then it falls: %s damage, and allies are restored by 30%% of their health.
skill.beyondsolo.thorn_volley.desc: Throw a fan of thorns: %s damage to foes in front of you, and the venom starts to build.
skill.beyondsolo.healing_sprout.flavour: Plant it, and it looks after you.
skill.beyondsolo.healing_sprout.desc: Plant a sprout where you are looking. For 10 s it mends the most wounded ally within 7 blocks for %s every second, and pricks foes that come close for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.barkskin.flavour: Rough, and all the better for it.
skill.beyondsolo.bramble_rush.desc: Brambles tear out of the ground in a line 10 blocks long: %s damage, foes are thrown up, slowed for 3 s and poisoned.
skill.beyondsolo.second_spring.desc: Flowers open around you and each ally within 8 blocks: %s health at once, regeneration for %s s, and poison and wither are washed away.
skill.beyondsolo.briar_coat.desc: Creatures that strike you in melee take %s damage and are poisoned.
skill.beyondsolo.spore_cloud.desc: A ring of mushrooms bursts into spores where you are looking, for 6 s. Foes within 4 blocks take %s damage twice a second, are poisoned and weakened; allies in the cloud are slowly mended.
skill.beyondsolo.grasping_vines.desc: Vines seize up to 5 foes within 10 blocks: %s damage, they are dragged towards you, held for 3 s and poisoned.
skill.beyondsolo.toxic_bloom.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to poisoned creatures.
skill.beyondsolo.elderwood.flavour: Older than the gate. Older than the hunters.
skill.beyondsolo.elderwood.desc: A great tree grows in front of you and stands for 12 s. Its roots strike foes within 10 blocks for %s damage and hold them for 5 s. Every second under its crown allies are mended for %s and cleansed of poison, and foes take %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.spring_bolt.flavour: Cold, clear and to the point.
skill.beyondsolo.spring_bolt.desc: Throw a bolt of spring water at the creature you are looking at: %s damage and it is slowed for 2 s. The most wounded ally within 8 blocks is mended for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.bubble_ward.desc: Wrap the ally you are looking at (or yourself) in a bubble for 6 s: %s absorption, no fire can touch them, and they are mended for %s. When it bursts it mends allies and soaks foes around it.
skill.beyondsolo.clear_mind.desc: You regain %s more mana every second.
skill.beyondsolo.fated_blow.desc: Foretell a blow on the creature you are looking at. Three seconds later it lands: %s damage, plus %s%% of all the damage you dealt to it in the meantime.
skill.beyondsolo.premonition.desc: %s drops of water circle you for 12 s. Each one swallows a blow whole and mends you for %s as it bursts.
skill.beyondsolo.second_sight.flavour: You know when the end is near.
skill.beyondsolo.second_sight.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to creatures under 35%% health.
skill.beyondsolo.morning_mist.flavour: Hard to hit what you cannot find.
skill.beyondsolo.morning_mist.desc: Mist rises around you for 6 s. %s%% of the blows aimed at allies in it miss, and they are slowly mended. Foes in the mist are slowed and take %s damage every second.
skill.beyondsolo.gaze_of_fate.desc: An eye of water opens over the spot you are looking at for 8 s. Foes within 8 blocks are revealed and take %s%% more damage from everyone, and %s damage at once.
skill.beyondsolo.foretold.flavour: The first one is always expected.
skill.beyondsolo.foretold.desc: The first blow each creature lands on you deals %s%% less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.eternal_spring.desc: A great spring bursts from the ground in front of you for 12 s. Every second allies within 10 blocks are mended for %s, cleansed, and regain mana. Every third second a wave rolls out: %s damage, and foes are pushed back.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_lance.flavour: A little of yours for a lot of theirs.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_lance.desc: A lance of blood through everything in a line 16 blocks long: %s damage, and they start to bleed. Costs %s health.
skill.beyondsolo.transfusion.desc: Give %s%% of the health you have left. Allies within 8 blocks are mended for two and a half times as much, and for 8 s you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.sanguine_pact.desc: Your hits heal you for %s%% of the damage they deal.
skill.beyondsolo.open_wounds.desc: The creature you are looking at bleeds for 5 s: %s damage twice a second, and it is slowed. If it dies bleeding it bursts: %s damage to foes within 3 blocks, and you are mended.
skill.beyondsolo.exsanguinate.desc: For 3 s, draw the blood of every foe within 7 blocks: %s damage twice a second, and you are healed for %s%% of it.
skill.beyondsolo.red_thirst.desc: You deal %s%% more damage to creatures that are bleeding or under half health.
skill.beyondsolo.crimson_thorns.desc: Spikes of hardened blood burst up in a line 10 blocks long: %s damage, foes are thrown up and bleed heavily. Costs %s health.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_rite.desc: Give %s%% of the health you have left. Foes within 8 blocks take %s damage plus twice what you paid, and if anything bled for it, what you paid returns over 5 s.
skill.beyondsolo.coagulate.desc: For 5 s after you pay health for a skill, you take %s%% less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.blood_tempest.desc: Give 30%% of the health you have left to call a rain of blood for 8 s. Foes within 10 blocks take %s damage twice a second and you are healed for 30%% of it. It ends in a burst: %s damage, and allies are restored by a quarter of their health.
skill.beyondsolo.first_light.desc: A beam of dawn through everything in a line 20 blocks long: %s damage, doubled for the undead. Allies in its path are mended for %s, and you for half of that.
skill.beyondsolo.benison.desc: Bless yourself and allies within 12 blocks: %s health at once, regeneration for 6 s, and under their halo they take %s%% less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctity.desc: Your healing is %s%% stronger and you deal %s%% more damage.
skill.beyondsolo.seraph_wings.desc: A beat of your wings throws back foes within 6 blocks for %s damage. For %s s you run faster, leap higher, fall gently, and allies near you are mended.
skill.beyondsolo.chakram_of_dawn.desc: Throw a disc of dawn that leaps between up to 6 foes: %s damage each, doubled for the undead. Every strike mends you a little, and when it returns allies within 6 blocks are mended for %s.
skill.beyondsolo.rapture.desc: Up to 6 foes within 12 blocks are lifted in shafts of light and thrown back to the ground: %s damage, doubled for the undead, and a 2 s stun.
skill.beyondsolo.sanctum.desc: Raise a sanctum around you for 5 s. Allies inside take %s%% less damage and are mended; foes are driven out and take %s damage every second they stay.
skill.beyondsolo.radiant_soul.desc: +%s maximum mana, and you regain %s more mana every second.
skill.beyondsolo.avatar_of_dawn.desc: Become the dawn for %s s: you cannot be killed, you deal 40%% more damage and heal half again as much. Every other second a shaft of light strikes a foe within 14 blocks for %s damage, and every second allies within 12 blocks are mended for %s.
